scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,APP" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix infra start" "npm --prefix mobile run web"
scripts.chaos: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/toggle-chaos').then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>console.log(d.message)).catch(()=>console.error('Backend not running — start with: npm run dev'))"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix infra install && npm --prefix mobile install
